definitions.natural_load: Saved physical natural P, not measured P; 200 kW base; signed net terminal demand.
definitions.DR: Saved delivered stochastic response without clipping; 0.25-hour energy sums. Absolute energy counts both directions; net energy is signed.
definitions.voltage_response: Same-background paired AC V(strategy)-V(zero), actual physical voltages, no measurement noise.
definitions.increment_prediction: Frozen historical non-tree A0: deltaP@R0.T+deltaQ@X0.T versus paired physical squared-drop increment Vzero**2-Vstrategy**2; common root cancels.
definitions.units: millipu=0.001 pu voltage; micro=1e-6 pu^2 squared voltage drop.
definitions.hybrid: Post hoc mechanism diagnosis: actual observed Y plus (A0 predicted increment minus true AC increment), retaining same actual background, same meter realization, actual measured P/Q and frozen candidate matrices. This uses actual paired physical data and is not deployable prediction or new optimization.
definitions.inference_unit: 12 complete independent synthetic paths, three profiles with four replicates each. Node/time cells in descriptive quantiles are not independent trials.
definitions.boundaries: No new AC, no refit, no new search, no repricing, no topology truth read. Existing unsafe component deliveries remain included. Results concern the fixed two-candidate validation stage.
